panels.heading: Starting from zero
panels.body: Tune-Up, El Puma Contigo, Argnetina Campeon del Mundo, Machine Stock — built from a blank screen, with a clean architecture decided on day one. On Tune-Up that includes the agent pipeline itself: shared skills, planner / builder / reviewer roles, and the right model for each task to keep costs in check.

panels.heading: Starting from someone else's mess
panels.body: Techint's internal app, PassApp, Be Soul — codebases with years of decisions already baked in, sometimes no tests at all. Same method: understand what's there before touching it, build the safety net, then change what needs changing. On EQM that meant 2,000+ tests first, then the full core migrated to TypeScript with AI in about a month.

closingNote: Either way, I document as I go and build the kind of test coverage that makes AI-assisted changes safe instead of risky — which is also how I ended up leading the first AI agent shipped inside a real product, not the kind you just use to write one.
